definitions.meaning: Tax or rent paid in food

quotations.old_english: On sumen lande gebúr sceal syllan huniggafol, on suman metegafol, on suman ealugafol

source_text: mete-gafol, es; n. Tax or rent paid in food :-- On sumen lande gebúr sceal syllan huniggafol, on suman metegafol, on suman ealugafol, L. R. S. 4; Th. i. 434, 32.
